missing: llama-server binary. Run `localcoder setup`, or download the llama.cpp release for your platform from https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases — llama-b<NNNN>-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz (Linux x64 CPU), llama-b<NNNN>-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz (Apple Silicon), or llama-b<NNNN>-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip (Windows) — extract the WHOLE folder (the binary needs the .so/.dylib/.dll files next to it) and pass --llama-server <folder>/llama-server

a GGUF coding model that fits this machine's memory budget (see `localcoder doctor`). Run `localcoder setup`, or for a small budget download Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf (~1 GB) from https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF ; with more RAM Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf (~4.4 GB). Then pass --model <file>.gguf
